description: Agent Nonprofit Records: submit board and governance records: the bylaws with their reference, the directors they require present for a quorum and the directors seated; each board meeting with its id, reference, the moment held and the minutes recorded for it; each vote with its id, reference, the meeting, the matter, the directors present, whether the record notes a quorum and the directors recorded as recused; each conflict of interest with its id, the director who declared it, the matter, the vote it relates to and the moment declared; each budget period with its id, period, the total the board approved, the total the spending records follow and the currency. The signed report gives the bylaws and the meetings, each meeting against its minutes, each vote against a quorum noted or a count of directors present, each declared conflict against the recusals on the related vote, and each board-approved budget against the budget the spending records follow, and counts them, and names divergent board and governance records: a meeting recorded with no minutes, a vote recorded with no quorum noted, a conflict of interest declared by a director with no recusal recorded on the related vote, and a board-approved budget that does not match the budget the spending records follow; then a vote taken with fewer directors present than the bylaws’ quorum and a vote naming a meeting the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No meetings, no votes, no quorum beside counts of directors present, or a conflict naming no vote the records hold leaves those points unverified. Meetings and votes match by letters and digits, directors without case, accents or punctuation, a conflict relates to the vote it names or to each vote whose matter carries every word of the conflict’s matter, and budgets compare to the cent. This reads a nonprofit’s own board and governance records: wever_atlas-market-brief and wever_atlas-stage-brief summarize the published Tokenization Atlas dataset for investors, while the board check reads the organization’s own meetings, votes, conflicts and budgets. Verdict nonprofit_board_divergent, nonprofit_board_partial, nonprofit_board_unverified or nonprofit_board_consistent. POST /api/nonprofit-board-check. Reads the nonprofit records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it solicits no donation, contacts no donor, files no form and gives no tax or legal advice, which stay with the organization and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Nonprofit Records reads a nonprofit’s own records: donation records, pledge records, restricted-gift records, fundraising campaign records, board and governance records, volunteer records, program spending records and the annual report written for donors and the public, each against the acknowledgment and ledger records, the collections, the spending records, the gift records and costs, the bylaws, votes and budgets, the shift records and policy, the mission and grant-purpose records or the records underneath it. The family’s ground is the nonprofit’s own house: money given, promises made by donors, restrictions placed on gifts, and what the board and the annual report say about all of it; the Agent Grants family reads the grant side, applications out and awards in, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the government, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-nonprofit-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-nonprofit-records/.

recused.description: The directors recorded as recused from the vote.
